VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: WIT

The reviewer note (WIT class) identifies a critical gap: while the agent fixed the internal storage of net positions as signed 64-bit integers, the report formatter still casts to unsigned, causing negative values to display incorrectly. This means the acceptance criterion "netting rounding drift is eliminated" is only partially satisfied—the underlying calculation may be correct, but the settlement output (which parties rely on) still presents wrong values for negative nets. The agent's self-report (SELF class) claims all 52 tests pass, but doesn't address display/output correctness, which is essential for a settlement system where stakeholders must see accurate figures.
